topic_title: Dangers of Speed and Street Racing Statutes
prompt: Can individuals who attend or coordinate illegal street racing takeovers be criminally prosecuted in Texas?

options.text: No, state criminal laws apply strictly and exclusively to the behind-the-wheel drivers
Only if spectators bring professional camera recording equipment to the scene
Only if spectators refuse to show proof of automotive liability insurance
Yes, spectators and organizers can be charged with Class B or Class A misdemeanors
